9.2.2 Frame reception in slave nodes
This section is only applicable to LIN slave nodes.
The following use case (Figure 9.5) shows the reception of a LIN frame. After a re-
ceived LIN header is indicated by the LIN driver, the PID is evaluated (shown by func-
tion EvaluatePID). If it’s determined to belong to a reception frame, the LIN inter-
face informs the driver about the response type by setting the appropriate members of
PduPtr (shown by function SetPduPtrValues).
The AllocateRxBuffer call is to show that the storage of the received frame is made
in the LIN Driver and not in the LIN Interface.
